# SwiftMandarin — Reverse-Mode ("中文母语者学英语") Implementation Plan

## 0. Ground truth established before planning

Three facts change the shape of this plan versus what the nine audits assumed:

**(A) The abstraction already exists and is dead code.** `/Users/rogerlin/Downloads/SwiftMandarin-main/SwiftMandarin/Models/LearningContext.swift` (163 lines) already defines exactly the `LearningContext` type the audits asked for — `learningIsChinese`, `nativeIsChinese`, `mirrored`, `primary(chinese:english:)`, `secondary(chinese:english:)`, `learningSpeechCode`, `nativeSpeechCode`, `speechCode(isChinese:)`, `showsPinyinAffordances`, `interactiveReaderIsChinese`, `learningLanguagePromptName`, `nativeLanguagePromptName`, `.current`, `speakLearning/speakNative/speakPair`. A repo-wide grep for `LearningContext` outside its own file returns **zero hits**. Its header comment references `scripts/learning-direction-checks/`, which **does not exist** (`ls scripts/` → ai-prompt-checks, audio-session-checks, minimax-audio-checks, vocabulary-paging-checks only).
→ **Do not design a new abstraction. Adopt, extend, and wire up this one.** That converts "invent a helper layer" into "migrate 87 `learningIsChinese` call sites onto an already-written, already-`Sendable` value type."

**(B) The build uses `fileSystemSynchronizedGroups`** (`SwiftMandarin.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj:137-139`). Any new `.swift` file dropped under `SwiftMandarin/` compiles automatically — no pbxproj edit needed. `knownRegions = (en, Base, "zh-Hans")` (`:166-170`).

**(C) There is no offline English phonetics source anywhere.** No bundled dictionary resource exists (`find SwiftMandarin -type f ! -name "*.swift"` → only xcstrings, entitlements, asset catalogs, icons). Apple ships no text→IPA API (`AVSpeechSynthesisIPANotationAttribute` is an *input* to TTS, not an output). `EnglishTextAnalyzer` exposes only `analyzeWords`, `analyzeSentences`, `isEnglish`, `detectLanguage`, `uniqueWords` — surface form, lemma, POS. **Therefore IPA must arrive from the AI model** through the existing `pinyin`/`reading` response fields, with a deterministic offline *syllable + stress* heuristic as the fallback. This is the single largest new-code item in the plan and it must be scoped honestly.

**(D) Catalog measured, not estimated.** 1210 entries; 1141 have zh-Hans (all `translated`); 69 have none. Classified by required action: 44 hard-coded bilingual literals needing a source-level split, 5 Chinese-authored keys, 10 English-only keys, 10 format/blank no-ops. Separately, **63 keys do not exist in the catalog at all** and must be created as part of the `Text(String)` → `Text(LocalizedStringKey)` conversions. Exact lists in §7.

---

## 1. The minimal set of new abstractions

Five additions total. Everything else is a migration onto them.

### 1.1 `LearningContext` — extend the existing file (no new file)
`SwiftMandarin/Models/LearningContext.swift`

Add to the pure `nonisolated struct` (keeps it Foundation-only and testable):

```swift
// Reading / phonetic affordance
enum ReadingKind: String, Sendable { case pinyin, ipa, none }
var learningReadingKind: ReadingKind { learningIsChinese ? .pinyin : .ipa }
func readingKind(isChinese: Bool) -> ReadingKind { isChinese ? .pinyin : .ipa }

// Direction defaults
var defaultDirection: TranslationDirection { learningIsChinese ? .englishToChinese : .chineseToEnglish }
var recognitionLanguagePriority: [String] {
    learningIsChinese ? ["zh-Hans","zh-Hant","en-US","en-GB"] : ["en-US","en-GB","zh-Hans","zh-Hant"]
}

// Bridge to the prompt layer so there is exactly one direction source
@MainActor func explanationDirection(forWord word: String) -> ExplanationDirection {
    ExplanationDirection(wordIsChinese: word.containsCJK, explainInChinese: nativeIsChinese)
}
```

`TranslationDirection` lives in `SwiftMandarin/Models/TranslationDirection.swift` and is Foundation-only, so referencing it keeps `LearningContext` compilable by the standalone runner.

### 1.2 `EnglishPhonetics` — new file
`SwiftMandarin/Services/EnglishPhonetics.swift`

The structural peer of `PinyinConverter` (which has 55 call sites across 20 files). Deterministic, Foundation-only, no network:

```swift
enum EnglishPhonetics {
    static func syllables(_ word: String) -> [String]      // vowel-group heuristic + common suffix rules
    static func syllableCount(_ word: String) -> Int
    static func stressIndex(_ word: String) -> Int?        // suffix-driven: -tion/-ity/-ic → penult/antepenult; 2-syll noun→1, verb→2
    static func stressMarked(_ word: String) -> String     // "seren·DIP·i·ty"
    static func normalizeIPA(_ raw: String) -> String      // trim, ensure /…/ slashes, strip duplicated stress marks
    static func colored(ipa: String) -> AttributedString   // stressed syllable emphasized — mirror of coloredPinyin
}
```

**Contract:** `stressMarked` is always available offline; true IPA is *only* what the model returned, run through `normalizeIPA`. Never fabricate IPA locally.

### 1.3 `PartOfSpeechLabels` — new file
`SwiftMandarin/Models/PartOfSpeechLabels.swift`

One localized-display map shared by `PartOfSpeechCategory` (`LearningActivity.swift:92-103`), `PartOfSpeech` (`ChineseTextAnalyzer.swift:153-158`), and `EnglishPartOfSpeech` (`EnglishTextAnalyzer.swift:15-28`).
**Critical constraint:** raw values are persisted keys (`DailyActivity.wordsByPartOfSpeech`, `LearningActivity.swift:30`) **and** Swift Charts scale keys (`StatsView.swift:409-421 posColorScale`, `:425-438 colorForPartOfSpeech`). Raw values must not change; only a `localizedLabel` is added.

### 1.4 `LearnerContent` — new file
`SwiftMandarin/Models/LearnerContent.swift`

Direction-selected seed data, so no view branches on decks inline:
```swift
enum LearnerContent {
    @MainActor static var starterDeck: [LearningCard]     // LearningDeck.cards | LearningDeck.englishCards
    @MainActor static var phraseCategories: [PhraseCategory]
}
```

### 1.5 `scripts/learning-direction-checks/` — new test harness
`scripts/test-learning-direction.sh` + `scripts/learning-direction-checks/LearningDirectionChecksRunner.swift`, cloned from the shape of `scripts/test-ai-prompt-contracts.sh` (opt-in `-D` flag, `swiftc` standalone, `-swift-version 6 -strict-concurrency=complete -warnings-as-errors`). Asserts the **mirror property**: for every accessor, `ctx.accessor(a,b) == ctx.mirrored.accessor(b,a)`. This is the regression gate that keeps the two directions symmetric.
